name: Knights of Columbus Hall, Patchogue
parkingNotes: Google Maps lists a wheelchair-accessible parking lot.
accessibilityNotes: Google Maps lists a wheelchair-accessible entrance, parking lot, restroom and seating.
reviewNotes:
Off Waverly Ave. Google Maps names it "Monseigneur Hall / Patchogue Knights of Columbus".

Directory research 2026-10-04: Address and phone confirmed on the council's own site and Google Maps. The site's HTTPS certificate is broken (it is issued for server301.com), so https://kofc725.com/ shows a security warning; the website is recorded as http://kofc725.com/ (works). The logo is the Knights of Columbus order's general logo used on the council site (small, 301x72 px), not a council-specific emblem. Google Maps shows Sunday 9 AM-6 PM, but the hall has no public opening hours (it is rented by event), so hours are left blank. The hall-rentals page is recorded as the booking link for renting the hall. Photos picked from the hall-rentals gallery avoid images showing guests' faces; photo files are large originals (3-4 MB, 4032 px) and may carry EXIF rotation. No public email or Instagram found.
description: The Knights of Columbus Council 725 hall, called Monseigneur Hall, on West 1st Street in Patchogue just off Waverly Avenue. The renovated hall has a wood dance floor, holds up to 130 people and is rented for parties and dances.

logo.alt: Knights of Columbus logo: the order's shield emblem beside the words Knights of Columbus
logo.credit: Logo: Knights of Columbus (Patchogue Council 725 website)
